'''Bessel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Deck officer/Legends|Deck Officer]] who served onboard the [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
